statement: Codex defines traceability/product tracing as the ability to follow the movement of a food through specified stages of production, processing and distribution.

review.rationale: Drafted from the currently adopted Codex definition/guidance for traceability/product tracing and verified against current Codex pages on September 15, 2026. The definition is used as an international transferable traceability principle, not as cannabis law. Codex was actively revising CXG 60-2006 in 2026, so the review due date is intentionally short.
review.notes: Human traceability/standards review is required before promotion. Recheck the adopted Codex text because a revision is in the Codex process during 2026.

sourceContext.contextTitle: Movement, Inventory and Vendor-Neutral Tracking Records
